Subject: [Perl Jobs] Perl/AJAX Software Engineer (onsite), United States, IL, Chicago area (Arlington Heights)

Online URL for this job: http://jobs.perl.org/job/2853

To subscribe to this list, send mail to jobs-subscribe@perl.org.
To unsubscribe, send mail to jobs-unsubscribe@perl.org.

Posted: February 10, 2008

Job title: Perl/AJAX Software Engineer

Company name: Where2GetIt

Location:
United States, IL, Chicago area (Arlington Heights)

Travel: 0%

Terms of employment: Salaried employee

Length of employment: Permanent Full Time

Hours: Full time

Onsite: yes

Description:
Where2GetIt is a fast paced organization in the middle of one of the
hottest Internet growth areas, location based services. Our continued
growth and success is dependent upon highly motivated and highly skilled
developers. If you want to join a team of like-minded developers, this is
the place for you. We have a passion for open source technologies and hope
you do too.  With hundreds of clients around the world, we help consumers
find where to buy our client's products (either online or offline). 

This position will have the opportunity to work on all aspects of the
consumer experience. From front end AJAX, to server side Perl/mod_perl to
the database.

Competitive salary and full benefits.

Required skills:
3+ years experience using Perl
2+ years experience with Apache & mod_perl
2+ years experience with Javascript and XML
Experience with Oracle, PostgreSQL and/or Mysql
Familiarity with AJAX programming methodologies
BS in Computer Science or comparable experience
Must have worked on commercially deployed applications through the full
product lifecycle
Highly self-motivated and effective team player
Experience in high volume Internet applications
Experience with object oriented Perl
History working in subversion
Excellent verbal and written communication skills a must

Must be local to the Chicago region or willing to relocate. No sponsorships
available.


Contact information at:
http://jobs.perl.org/job/2853#contact
